answer.recommendation: Plan the December 2 visit to Riverside plant to work on pump P-14 with a crew of 3, arriving through the north gate, which the work packet lists as open. Before the visit, confirm with site contacts that the north gate is still open on December 2 and note its hours. Confirm the work scope for P-14 (inspection, maintenance, or repair) so the crew brings the right tools, parts, and documentation. Confirm lockout/tagout and any site safety or permit requirements for the pump, and confirm the crew's PPE and site induction status. Agree on a meeting point and a contact person on arrival, and set a backup entrance plan in case the north gate is closed. Assign roles across the three crew members (for example, lead technician, support, and documentation/logging) and plan the visit timing around the site's operating schedule.
quality_notes: The work packet does not include a visit time, arrival window, or departure time; these need to be confirmed.
The packet does not state the year for December 2, so the date should be verified against the scheduling system.
The scope of work on pump P-14 is not specified, so tools, parts, and the crew's skill mix cannot be fully confirmed.
The entrance status 'north gate open' is recorded in the packet but may not be current; it should be re-verified closer to the visit date.
No safety, permit, or lockout/tagout requirements are listed in the packet, so these were recommended as items to confirm rather than stated facts.
No colleague was contacted; the recommendation relies only on the supplied work packet and therefore has gaps that a site contact should close.
